answer: The Translation bundle passing automated tests backed by a reputation bond ties standing to delivered value: the translation bundle is reviewed line by line, the reputation bond is released only when the work is accepted, and a rejected submission costs the applicant time and money, so an identity is earned by doing something useful, not by filling in a form. Even a quiet velvet gets heard, because review weighs substance, not volume. The lotus hides nothing and the kernel reveals everything: the review trail is open to all.
